test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Padma Bhushan, Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam is renowned for having trained hundreds of students in which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The Correct Answer __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi**

 
 
• Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam is celebrated for his contributions to Kuchipudi, a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• He played a pivotal role in popularizing Kuchipudi on the global stage, transforming it from a dance-drama tradition to a solo performance art.
 
• Under his guidance, hundreds of students have mastered the art of Kuchipudi, thereby ensuring the continuity and growth of this dance form.
 
• His efforts earned him the prestigious Padma Bhushan award, recognizing his significant contributions to the field of Indian classical dance.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Kuchipudi
 A classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh known for its graceful movements and strong narrative storytelling.
 
 

 Odissi
 An ancient Indian classical dance from Odisha, characterized by its fluidity of movement and sculptural poses.
 
 

 Bharatnatyam
 One of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, originating from Tamil Nadu, noted for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork.
 
 

 Kathak
 A North Indian classical dance form known for its fast footwork (tatkar), spins (chakkar), and the storytelling (abhinaya).
